Mantener y resolver incidencias en servicios de AI en producción: chatbots de soporte, validación de documentos (fiscal y bancario), bots de Slack, dashboards y plataforma de agentes Monitorear estabilidad y performance en AWS (Lambdas, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM, Amplify) y actuar rápido ante alertas o degradaciones Gestionar el ciclo completo de deployment: generación de ZIPs de Lambda, despliegue a dev/prod, validación y monitoreo post-deploy Diseñar e implementar proyectos nuevos del roadmap de AI, desde RFC hasta deployment y observabilidad en producción Desarrollar mejoras, bugfixes y nuevas features en proyectos existentes con estándares de código y documentación del equipo Documentar de forma exhaustiva (README, CLAUDE.md, RFCs, runbooks, .env.example) para que el conocimiento no dependa de una sola persona Colaborar con equipos externos (producto, operaciones, partners) para integrar y dar soporte a servicios de AI consumidos por otras áreas ¿Cómo se verá tu éxito? Tiempo promedio de resolución de incidencias menor a 4 horas 99.5% de uptime en servicios de AI en producción Ownership autónomo de al menos 3 proyectos en los primeros 3 meses 1 proyecto nuevo diseñado e implementado end-to-end dentro del primer año 100% de repositorios bajo tu responsabilidad con documentación actualizada (README, CLAUDE.md, .env.example) En los primeros 90 días , se verá que ya puedes tomar ownership de proyectos en producción, operar deployments con confianza y responder incidentes con diagnósticos claros y documentación accionable ¿Qué estamos buscando? Nivel: recién egresado/a o 1–2 años de experiencia Python sólido (backend, AWS Lambda, scripting) Integración con APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic): prompt engineering, manejo de tokens, evaluación de respuestas Nociones prácticas de AWS serverless: Lambda, API Gateway, Amplify, CloudWatch, IAM (no necesitas ser experto/a; aquí se aprende) MongoDB: schemas, queries, agregaciones, optimización Debugging y resolución de incidencias en producción en sistemas con múltiples servicios Git y documentación técnica clara (READMEs, RFCs, runbooks) Mentalidad AI-first: que el uso de herramientas tipo ChatGPT/Copilot/LLMs sea parte natural de cómo resuelves problemas Lo que buscamos en ti Son ágiles mentalmente, con criterio propio y capacidad para tomar buenas decisiones en contextos de ambigüedad Son autónomas, estructuradas y orientadas a resultados Piensan en sistemas, procesos y métricas, no solo en tareas Se sienten cómodas tomando decisiones y asumiendo responsabilidad Tienen energía y empuje para ejecutar Actúan con integridad, incluso cuando nadie está mirando Se obsesionan con el cliente Buscan constantemente mejorar, simplificar y escalar ¿Por qué unirte a T1? Tendrás impacto real desde el primer día Trabajarás en problemas complejos, relevantes y de alto alcance Construirás soluciones que usan miles de negocios todos los días Formarás parte de un equipo exigente, colaborativo y con estándares altos Crecerás al ritmo de una empresa que está escalando de verdad, no en teoría Tu impacto se reconoce y se recompensa de forma justa, competitiva y acorde a la responsabilidad del rol Si este reto resuena contigo, queremos conocerte. Postúlate y conversemos sobre cómo podrías aportar en T1.

Description: About The Job We are seeking a Data & Analytics Product Owner to lead the vision, strategy, and delivery of Supporting Functions (Finance, Legal, Human Resources, and Danone Business Services - DBS) data products across the Americas region. Working closely with global teams, regional stakeholders, and local IT business partners, this role will define and deliver cross-functional analytics capabilities that drive business performance and support data-driven decision making. The Product Owner will lead a team of Product Analysts and a cross-functional delivery squad of technical specialists using Agile Scrum way of working. This role is based in Mexico City, Mexico or Sao Paulo, Brazil. About You Position Purpose The Data and Analytics Product Owner will play a leading role in the organization’s digital transformation by driving modern data platform capabilities and advanced analytics solutions. Key objectives include Own and execute the product vision for Data and Analytics Supporting Functions across the Americas Enable business teams to leverage data, insights, and analytics as strategic assets Drive scalable data products and AI-enabled solutions that generate measurable business value Partner with business, regional, and global teams to identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities Lead Agile product delivery to maximize adoption, value realization, and business outcomes Context Data And Analytics Supporting Functions This role operates within the Americas Data and Analytics Supporting Functions squad and focuses on Data Management and Governance Data Analytics and Reporting Master Data Management Self Service Business Intelligence Advanced Analytics and AI capabilities The team leverages modern technologies including Azure Databricks Snowflake Power BI The organization delivers scalable and governed data products aligned with global standards and best practices. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy and Agile Delivery Own and manage the product vision, roadmap, and backlog Prioritize initiatives based on business value and strategic objectives Lead Agile Scrum ceremonies and ensure effective product delivery Drive measurable business outcomes through delivery squad performance Data and Analytics Solution Design Identify and assess opportunities for analytics and data products Translate business needs into scalable data and analytics solutions Enable the development and adoption of trusted, enterprise-wide data assets and reporting solutions Drive innovation through automation, machine learning, and AI-enabled capabilities Business Partnership and Stakeholder Management Partner with business stakeholders to define KPIs, use cases, and success metrics Act as the primary bridge between business and technical teams Drive adoption of data-driven decision making across the organization Data Governance and Platform Management Define and promote data governance standards and best practices Ensure data quality, integrity, security, and compliance Support the development of data models and lifecycle management processes Performance Management and Value Realization Track and measure product success through KPIs including User adoption Customer satisfaction Delivery velocity Data quality Business impact People Leadership Coach and develop Product Analysts Lead and influence cross-functional teams and external partners Continuous Improvement Partner with Product Owners, technical leads, and business teams to continuously enhance data maturity and capabilities Experience & Skills 8+ years of demonstrated experience delivering Data & Analytics products. Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Proven experience as a Product Owner or similar data product leadership role. Strong understanding of Agile Scrum. Experience with backlog management tools such as Jira. Strong ability to define requirements and write effective user stories. CPG/FMCG experience preferred. Technical & Functional Skills Experience as a Product Owner or similar role with Data & Analytics Strong understanding of Agile Scrum way of working. Experience with backlog management tools (e.g. Jira). Ability to clearly write and articulate functional requirements and user stories. Business & Domain Knowledge Strong understanding of Supporting Functions domains, including Financial Planning & Analysis Financial Reporting and Close processes Business process withing DBS, including Invoice to Cash, Record to Report, Accounts Payable, Treasury, Master Data Management, and Employee Services Human Resources Management Legal Understanding of planning cycles, key planning KPIs, and cross-functional business impacts. Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into actionable solutions. Technical Knowledge Extensive experience with Azure Databricks Snowflake Power BI Data governance frameworks and best practices Leadership Competencies Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Ability to influence in a matrixed and multicultural environment Strong ownership and accountability mindset Structured, proactive, and results-oriented approach Passion for continuous improvement and innovation Language Requirements English and Spanish fluency is mandatory (role supports US, Canada, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico). Portuguese is a plus (due to Brazil scope). About us At Danone Mexico, we work with a deep conviction people's health and the health of the planet are connected. Under our global vision One Planet. One Health. , we build a healthier future through food and beverages that are part of the daily lives of millions of families worldwide. In Mexico, with more than 15,000 employees, 35 plants, and over 100 distribution centers across the country, we are a diverse and highly committed community driving iconic brands such as Danone, Activia, Oikos, Danonino, Bonafont, and Silk. Every person who joins us brings a key piece to continue evolving and innovating. At Danone, you will find an environment where you can grow with purpose and be authentic. We value what each person contributes, and it is this combination of experiences, talents, and perspectives that strengthens our culture and drives us to achieve extraordinary results. Here, you will have the freedom to propose, create, and bring ideas to life that generate real impact. We foster your development through continuous feedback, clear objectives, agile methodologies, and learning tools designed to accelerate your professional growth. We want you to move forward with confidence and find a path that inspires you. Your well-being is also fundamental to us. That’s why we offer flexible benefits, comprehensive health programs covering physical, emotional, and financial well-being, support platforms, exclusive discounts, and benefits above the legal requirements—supporting you at every stage of your life. We are proudly a B Corp certified company, reflecting our commitment to responsible practices, conscious decisions, and a positive impact on people, communities, and the planet. If you are looking for a place where you can contribute, grow, and be part of a community driven by purpose, we invite you to explore our opportunities and discover for yourself everything you can build at Danone. Your next big professional step could start here.
